summary: Search, paid and social run together for a Gulf perfume brand, lifting product visibility and conversion.
challenge: Before TDM, the brand needed a professional eCommerce platform to showcase its perfume collection, simplify product discovery, and support secure online purchases.
approach: TDM developed a visually appealing Shopify store with responsive design, optimized product listings, product filters, shopping cart functionality, and secure payment gateways. The website improved user experience, supported SEO visibility, and created a smoother buying journey for fragrance customers.

testimonial.quote: TDM built a polished Shopify store that improved product presentation, user experience, and the overall shopping journey.
testimonial.author: Perfume e-commerce client, United Arab Emirates
